acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

balanceOf(address,uint256).details: Returns the value of tokens of token type `id` owned by `account`.

balanceOfBatch(address[],uint256[]).details: See {IERC1155-balanceOfBatch}. Requirements: - `accounts` and `ids` must have the same length.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns true if `operator` is approved to transfer ``account``'s tokens. See {setApprovalForAll}.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

safeBatchTransferFrom(address,address,ui.details: xref:ROOT:erc1155.adoc#batch-operations[Batched] version of {safeTransferFrom}. WARNING: This function can potentially allow a reentrancy attack when transferring tokens to an untrusted contract, when invoking {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155BatchReceived} on the receiver. Ensure to follow the checks-effects-interactions pattern and consider employing reentrancy guards when interacting with untrusted contracts. Emits either a {TransferSingle} or a {TransferBatch} event, depending on the length of the array arguments. Requirements: - `ids` and `values` must have the same length. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155BatchReceived} and return the acceptance magic value.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Transfers a `value` amount of tokens of type `id` from `from` to `to`. WARNING: This function can potentially allow a reentrancy attack when transferring tokens to an untrusted contract, when invoking {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155Received} on the receiver. Ensure to follow the checks-effects-interactions pattern and consider employing reentrancy guards when interacting with untrusted contracts. Emits a {TransferSingle} event. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been approved to spend ``from``'s tokens via {setApprovalForAll}. - `from` must have a balance of tokens of type `id` of at least `value` amount. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155Received} and return the acceptance magic value.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Grants or revokes permission to `operator` to transfer the caller's tokens, according to `approved`, Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event. Requirements: - `operator` cannot be the zero address.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

uri(uint256).details: See {IERC1155MetadataURI-uri}. This implementation returns the same URI for *all* token types. It relies on the token type ID substitution mechanism https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1155#metadata[defined in the ERC]. Clients calling this function must replace the `\{id\}` substring with the actual token type ID.

finalizeIssuance().notice: Permanently fix the supply at the IDs issued so far.

holdersPage(uint256,uint256).notice: Holders of IDs firstId..firstId+count-1 (zero address for IDs that do not exist).

issue(address,uint256).notice: Issue the next `count` IDs (supply+1 .. supply+count) to `to` in one batch.

retract(uint256).notice: Before finalization, undo over-issuance: burn the highest `count` IDs, all of which         must still be held by the issuer. IDs held by anyone else can never be retracted.

totalSupply().notice: Number of issued IDs; the IDs are exactly 1..totalSupply().

safeBatchTransferFrom(address,address,ui.details: xref:ROOT:erc1155.adoc#batch-operations[Batched] version of {safeTransferFrom}. WARNING: This function can potentially allow a reentrancy attack when transferring tokens to an untrusted contract, when invoking {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155BatchReceived} on the receiver. Ensure to follow the checks-effects-interactions pattern and consider employing reentrancy guards when interacting with untrusted contracts. Emits either a {TransferSingle} or a {TransferBatch} event, depending on the length of the array arguments. Requirements: - `ids` and `values` must have the same length. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155BatchReceived} and return the acceptance magic value.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Transfers a `value` amount of tokens of type `id` from `from` to `to`. WARNING: This function can potentially allow a reentrancy attack when transferring tokens to an untrusted contract, when invoking {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155Received} on the receiver. Ensure to follow the checks-effects-interactions pattern and consider employing reentrancy guards when interacting with untrusted contracts. Emits a {TransferSingle} event. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been approved to spend ``from``'s tokens via {setApprovalForAll}. - `from` must have a balance of tokens of type `id` of at least `value` amount. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC1155Receiver-onERC1155Received} and return the acceptance magic value.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Grants or revokes permission to `operator` to transfer the caller's tokens, according to `approved`, Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event. Requirements: - `operator` cannot be the zero address.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

accrual().notice: Allocation of the income already recognized (totalAccounted).

activate(uint256,uint256).notice: Fix both category denominators. Both receipt collections must have finalized issuance,         and the supplies must equal the values the operator reviewed.

claim(uint8,uint256).notice: Claim the income attached to one receipt ID held by the caller.

claimBatch(uint256[],uint256[]).notice: Claim the income attached to any number of NAND and LATCH IDs held by the caller.

claimable(uint8,uint256).notice: Income the current holder of `id` can claim now (including unrecognized balance).

depositMiners(uint256[]).notice: Admit miners owned by the caller (requires ERC-721 approval to this pool).

harvest(uint256[]).notice: Ordinary harvest: claim the listed registered miners under the current composition.         Failures are isolated per miner and reported; only actual balance increases count.

harvestRange(uint256,uint256).notice: Harvest registry entries [start, start+count) (clamped to the registry length).

previewAccrual().notice: Allocation after the next sync (adds BEM held but not yet recognized). Income still         inside Mining is not included anywhere: it becomes income only when it is received.

reconciliation().notice: Full ledger snapshot; see docs/ACCOUNTING.md for the identities.

registerMiners(uint256[]).notice: Admit miners that already reached the pool by a plain transfer. Same whitelist and         the same settlement boundary as `depositMiners`; a plain transfer alone admits nothing.

releaseA().notice: Pay recipient A its accrued 1/102. Callable by anyone; independent of all other payments.

releaseB().notice: Pay recipient B its accrued 1/102. Callable by anyone; independent of all other payments.

setRecipient(uint8,address).notice: A recipient may move its own role (e.g. to a new multisig). Unpaid income stays with         the role. Nobody else, including the owner, can change a recipient.

sync().notice: Recognize BEM that reached the pool by any route as income of the current period.

unrecognizedBalance().notice: BEM held beyond the ledger. Stays unrecognized while no miner has been admitted.
